post.title: Novelcrafter wants $8 a month. Novelmaker wants nothing.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: an AI writing room for novels that stops billing when the writing stops, and a Mac app that casts any video to the TV without a paid casting app.

segments.quote: I just wanted it without a website and without a subscription.

cues.say: Novelcrafter wants eight dollars a month

cues.cap: even in the months you write nothing.
“I just wanted it without a website
cues.say: [sarcastic] I just wanted it without a website

cues.cap: So: Novelmaker. On your own machine.
cues.say: [quick] So: Novelmaker. On your own machine.

segments.quote: Playing a video from your Mac on the TV shouldn't cost money

cues.cap: to put your video on the TV.
“Playing a video from your Mac on the TV
cues.say: [sarcastic] Playing a video from your Mac on the TV

cues.cap: So: Driftcast. Any file, any TV.
cues.say: [quick] So: Driftcast. Any file, any TV.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
